strategy.name: intraday_sma_local_parameter_window_stability
strategy.description: 以完整历史全局搜索赢家附近为预声明局部空间，保留全部短均线导数、成本止损、长期 SMA 兜底、长期 SMA/短均线恢复买入，并把强制买回作为可启用或完全关闭的离散模式。在 1999–2014、2005–2020、2010–2026 三个重叠窗口用同一候选全集分别优化 CAGR 与 Sharpe，再把每窗代表参数交叉应用到全部窗口，检查参数和排名是否稳定。
strategy.buy_rule: 初始空仓时由动态 H 日 SMA 上穿或价格上穿动态 F 三短均线平均值下方 G% 中任一规则全仓买入；强制买回模式开启且已有卖出价时，再加入卖出成交价上方 R% 买回，关闭时该规则完全不存在。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：成本价下方 L%；F 三短均线平均变化率连续 A 日为负且价格跌破动态 B 日 SMA；此前连续 D-1 日三短均线平均变化率为负且当日三条短 SMA 各自变化率均不高于 C%；动态 E 日 SMA 下穿。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前，只用截至前一交易日 Close 的历史计算条件单；2005 与 2010 窗口使用窗口开始前的 QQQ 历史预热指标，但预热期禁止交易。1999 窗口从 QQQ 上市首日开始，因不存在上市前数据只能自然预热。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日 Open 已越过阈值，按当日常规时段 Open；否则常规时段调整后 OHLC 触及阈值时按精确理论阈值；零滑点、零费用；每天最多一笔成交。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only，窗口开始时持有 100,000 美元现金；每次全仓持有或全现金，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 每个窗口独立从空仓开始，等待该参数在该窗口的第一笔普通买入；策略和该参数的 Buy & Hold 都从同一笔成交开始计绩效。

windows.warmup: QQQ inception; no pre-listing history exists
use approved QQQ closes before 2005-01-03; no pre-window trades
use approved QQQ closes before 2010-01-04; no pre-window trades

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: For every parameter/window independently, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at that case's first ordinary buy fill and hold through that window end.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse the accepted v3 controls unchanged. Build experiment-specific cross-window charts around the shared template; never render a per-order table, while retaining orders in machine ledgers and K-line marker hover.

research.hypothesis: If the full-history winner represents a broad and persistent mechanism rather than one historical accident, overlapping windows should select nearby parameters, their top-1% parameter distributions should overlap, and each window's CAGR/Sharpe representative should retain a high rank when applied to the other windows.
research.primary_metric: Independently optimize CAGR and Sharpe in each window; judge stability from exact winner distances, top-1% parameter distributions, cross-window CAGR/Sharpe rank percentiles, benchmark deltas, drawdown and turnover. Do not collapse the two objectives into one score.
research.selection_rule: Generate 40,000 fixed-seed candidates in the declared local grid, score the same candidates in all three windows, generate 15,000 additional unique mutations around each window's four metric frontiers, merge and de-duplicate all candidates, then rescore the same merged universe in all three windows. Select each window's single CAGR winner and single Sharpe winner plus the declared prior full-history anchor; merge duplicates and formally cross-check every representative in every window.
research.validation_plan: The compiled ledger must match the independent pandas ledger on a pre-window-warmup golden test. Every reported representative/window cross-case must match PyBroker on cash, shares, equity, dates, sides, shares and fills; formal metrics and first entry must reproduce the saved screening row within tolerance. All searches and ranks must be reproducible from the seed and saved universe.
research.promotion_criteria: No automatic promotion. A useful result requires materially overlapping top-1% ranges and high cross-window ranks for at least one parameter family under both CAGR and Sharpe; even then it only justifies a later locked non-overlapping or walk-forward experiment.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject the run if windows do not use exact available dates, pre-window rows create trades, candidates differ across final window comparisons, duplicate case/window rows exist, a representative cannot be found in every window, any first entry is an initial seed, daily trades exceed one, a disabled forced-reentry signal trades, or screening and formal ledgers disagree.
